protocol.reference_scope: archived a1 profile reproduced on a2
protocol.metric_scope: e2e aggregate includes prefill; client TPOT is stream-first-text to final usage; server decode TPOT sums request-phase durations, not pure kernel time
protocol.scope_limits: one synthetic fixed prompt; mirrored order, two boots per arm; not workload-wide optimality or long-duration load test

env.scope: archived-a1-profile on a2; endpoint only changed
archived-a1-profile on a2; endpoint only changed

metric_notes.client_generation_tok_s: 1/TPOT; first nonempty text to final usage, divided by output_tokens-1; MTP may stream multiple first-event tokens, so this is a long-output client estimate
metric_notes.server_decode_tok_s: output_tokens-minus-request-count divided by summed server request decode durations; per-request weighted metric, not aggregate throughput
metric_notes.e2e_aggregate_output_tok_s: all output tokens / round wall time; includes cold prefill and queueing
metric_notes.limits: one fixed synthetic prompt, 512 output; two boots per arm; no confidence interval or workload-wide optimum claim; reference windows sequential after mirrored MTP block
